enums.name: ke_result_domain
enums.doc: The domains that own a range of result codes. A domain's own codes are written `KE_RESULT_CODE(KE_RESULT_DOMAIN_ <DOMAIN >, n)` in its header, with `n` from 1 up.

enums.name: ke_result
enums.doc: What a fallible call returns: `KE_OK`, or the code of the failure. The detail of a failure goes to the failing library's log, never into the code. A caller treats a code it does not know as `KE_RESULT_GENERAL`. Ignoring the result of a call is a compiler warning where the compiler supports it.

structs.name: ke_io_dir_entry
structs.doc: One entry of a directory list_dir reported.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The entry's name, without its directory; owned by the list it is in.

structs.name: ke_io_result
structs.doc: What ke_io.wait reports of a request; each field is filled by the requests named on it.

fields.name: file
fields.doc: open: the file, released with ke_io.close.

fields.name: bytes
fields.doc: read_file: the file's bytes, owned by the caller and released with ke_io.free_bytes.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: read_file: the number of bytes; read_at: the number of bytes read.

fields.name: exists
fields.doc: file_exists: whether the path names a regular file; dir_exists: a directory.

fields.name: entries
fields.doc: list_dir: the entries, owned by the caller and released with ke_io.free_entries.

vtables.name: ke_io
vtables.doc: Reads files without blocking the caller: each slot that reads submits a request, which runs elsewhere and is waited on exactly once. A request never waited on is never released. Paths follow ke_file_system. Every slot may be called from several threads at once.

slots.name: read_file
slots.doc: Submits a read of a whole file.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null path or out_request, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: path
params.doc: The file to read; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: open
slots.doc: Submits the opening of a file for read_at.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null path or out_request, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: path
params.doc: The file to open; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: read_at
slots.doc: Submits a read from an open file at an offset; it reads fewer than len bytes only at the end of the file.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null file, a null dst with a non-zero len or a null out_request, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: file
params.doc: A file an open request reported.

params.name: offset
params.doc: Where the read starts, in bytes from the start of the file.

params.name: dst
params.doc: Receives the bytes; the caller's until wait returns.

params.name: len
params.doc: The number of bytes dst holds.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: stat
slots.doc: Submits an inspection of what a path names.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null path or out_request, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: path
params.doc: The path to inspect; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: file_exists
slots.doc: Submits the question whether a path names a regular file; a path that names nothing, or something else, is reported as no, not as a failure.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null path or out_request, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: path
params.doc: The path to ask about; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: dir_exists
slots.doc: Submits the question whether a path names a directory; a path that names nothing, or something else, is reported as no, not as a failure.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED when the implementation does not provide it, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: path
params.doc: The path to ask about; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: list_dir
slots.doc: Submits the listing of a directory's entries, in no particular order, without "." and "..".
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED when the implementation does not provide it, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: path
params.doc: The directory to list; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: write_file
slots.doc: Submits the writing of a whole file, which replaces what the path held only once every byte is written, so a failed write leaves the earlier file as it was.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED when the implementation does not provide it, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: path
params.doc: The file to write; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: bytes
params.doc: What the file holds afterwards; the caller's until wait returns.

params.name: len
params.doc: The number of bytes in bytes.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: make_dir
slots.doc: Submits the creation of a directory and of every missing directory above it; a directory that already exists is not a failure.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED when the implementation does not provide it, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: path
params.doc: The directory to create; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: remove
slots.doc: Submits the removal of a file or of an empty directory.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED when the implementation does not provide it, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: path
params.doc: What to remove; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: rename
slots.doc: Submits the renaming of a file or a directory, replacing a file already at to.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY, KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED when the implementation does not provide it, or the code the task pool refused the request with.

params.name: from
params.doc: What to rename; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: to
params.doc: Its new path; copied before the slot returns.

params.name: out_request
params.doc: Receives the request; null on failure.

slots.name: is_completed
slots.doc: Reports whether a request has finished, without releasing it. Valid only before the request is waited on.

params.name: request
params.doc: A request a submit slot returned.

slots.name: wait
slots.doc: Blocks until the request finishes, releases it, and reports what it read.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null request, the code the task pool refused the wait with, the request then still to be waited on, or the failure of the read: KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY or KE_RESULT_IO.

params.name: request
params.doc: A request a submit slot returned; invalid afterwards.

params.name: out_result
params.doc: Receives what the request read; left zeroed when it failed.

slots.name: close
slots.doc: Releases a file an open request reported; it is invalid afterwards. A null file is ignored.

params.name: file
params.doc: The file to release.

slots.name: free_bytes
slots.doc: Releases the bytes a read_file request reported. Null bytes are ignored.

params.name: bytes
params.doc: The bytes to release.

slots.name: free_entries
slots.doc: Releases the entries a list_dir request reported, their names with them. Null entries are ignored.

params.name: entries
params.doc: The entries to release.
